This southern-most Malaysian city is really full of must try things, not just the 7 must try things I highlight here - but they'll at least get you thinking and perhaps even inspire you to do the same, where Johor tourism is concerned! Johor Bahru, Malaysia, actually surprised me with its great food scene, which is dotted with super old and traditional restaurants. Furthermore, there are so many great people (as you will see) that are committed to making a difference in their community, where urban sustainability counts most. The city's urban sprawl can make getting around challenging, so this video's 7 must try things focuses mainly on the central region of Johor Bahru. My hope is that both locals and travelers will find this film both enjoyable and useful Enjoy this 7 MUST try things in Johor Bahru Malaysia!
